svg.title: Domain driven design
svg.desc: Three teams share one Order class with 60 fields, so promo codes, prep times, and courier routes each break someone else's tests. The class splits into ordering, kitchen, and delivery contexts, each with its own model and database. OrderPlaced becomes a kitchen ticket and a delivery job, FoodReady reaches delivery, and when the kitchen adds a rush flag nobody else's code changes.

g.text: every change breaks someone else's tests

svg.text: One Order class becomes three models that talk through events.
